resources.string: A short signal on your wrist
No paired devices. Pair Air in Google Health first, then return here.
Select Fitbit Air only. Google Health pairing and keys stay intact.
Command acknowledged and setting verified. Did you feel the signal?
Band unavailable. Check Bluetooth and distance.
Unknown outcome: the signal may have played. Check strength in Google Health; no automatic retry.
Channel handoff unconfirmed. Check Google Health synchronization.
Low and High change the band-wide setting on the next signal. Use Google Health setting preserves its current value.
Experimental build. Not yet tested on a physical Air. Unofficial app, not affiliated with Google or Fitbit.
Allow Bluetooth and notification access, select Air and apps. Turn on the main switch to test.
If Android restricts access, open AirNoti app info and use Allow restricted settings if available. You do not need to disable Play Protect.
